evals.prompt: I need to add a new block type called 'callout' to the Novident Editor. Where do I put the files and how do I register it so it shows up in the editor?
evals.expected_output: Points to lib/src/editor/block_component/callout_block_component/ with callout_block_component.dart + callout_character_shortcut.dart, registered in standard_block_components.dart, exported from the block_component barrel.

evals.prompt: Where does undo/redo logic live in this repo, and where would I add a new keyboard shortcut (e.g. Ctrl+Shift+K)?
evals.expected_output: Undo/redo in lib/src/history/undo_manager.dart (HistoryItem, FixedSizeStack); keyboard shortcuts via KeyboardStrategy policies in lib/src/editor/editor_component/service/shortcuts/.

evals.prompt: How do I run just the vim mode tests, and where do vim-related tests live?
evals.expected_output: Command: flutter test test/new/vim_mode/vim_mode_test.dart; tests mirror source under test/new/vim_mode/.
